title: Bright Star
paragraphs: Ziv-syndicated newspaper comedy-drama centered on Hillsdale Morning Star editor Susan Armstrong and reporter George Harvey. The frozen container preserves 31 numbered broadcasts from the 52-program run plus five OTRR reference tracks; all 31 surviving broadcast dates are recovered additively from specialist collection metadata.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Ziv syndicated run (October 23, 1952 to October 15, 1953).
Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Fred MacMurray (performer) and Irene Dunne (performer).

The stories often return to newspaper newsroom and local journalism, Susan and George romantic tension, small-town community life, performance, culture and publicity, family, matchmaking and old relationships, and swindles, crime and investigative reporting.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Ziv transcription syndication, Hollywood stars in syndicated radio, Newspaper comedy-drama, and Partial survival of a 52-program run.
